notes.title: Russian Language Update
notes.content:
There were reports that Russian version was unavailable and the previous fix was not fully functionining.
We have updated Steam settings to allow access to Russian language version.

We sincerely apologize for the delay.

tags.feature: We have updated Steam settings to allow access to Russian language version.
